non_goals: Launching dense full-volume before ROI QC
Serial 120-step retrain of the identical PGT002-001 config
Post-hoc candidate invention inside this freeze after seeing S1 scores

preserved_invariants.permanent_exclusions: validation_002 / batch_001 / smoke / discovery remain excluded

purpose: Replace serial train→diagnose→retrain with a frozen parallel qualification funnel: short-run several substantially different training candidates against the SAME frozen eval/gates, eliminate chance-level configs early, extend only survivors, then (only after affinity PASS) run a predeclared small ROI through affinities→segmentation→QC before any full-volume inference.
rationale_for_superseding_serial_failure: Run #001 already showed step 10 ≈ step 120 at balanced_acc=0.5 / non-positive margin. Serial arms B–D of the failure-analysis protocol test similar factors more slowly than a predeclared parallel short-run matrix. Construction preflight (former arm A) is retained as Stage 0. Evidence standard is not lowered: GATE_A–E and threshold 0.5 remain identical to AFFINITY_TRAINING_EXPERIMENT_CONTRACT_001.

stages.fail: CONSTRUCTION_DEFECT → archive; halt funnel; fix under new frozen contract (do not weaken GATE_D)
stages.procedure: Read-only audit: recompute patch/local for all PGT002 edges; assert one-voxel target and channel geometry; confirm scalar affinity index matches supervised voxel.

early_eliminate_rule_frozen_before_resul.note: Prospective rule justified by PGT002-001 plateau evidence. Uses frozen eval ONLY under this predeclared eliminate rule—not for inventing new candidates or retuning threshold after seeing scores.

stages.outputs: Per-candidate receipt + archive FAIL or SURVIVOR_SHORT

stages.eligibility: Candidates with status SURVIVOR_SHORT after S1
stages.if_zero_survivors: Funnel ends QUALIFICATION_FAIL; archive matrix summary; do not invent post-hoc candidates in the same freeze

stages.pass_rule: All GATE_A–E true on selected checkpoint (eval balanced_acc max; ties → lowest step)

stages.decision: Human records which PASS checkpoint is authorized for ROI inference (does not change gates/metrics)

stack: optional synapse/graph stubs remain CLOSED until seg QC PASS

stages.on_fail: Archive ROI failure + diagnostics; do not full-volume

stages.note: Only after ROI segmentation QC PASS

stages.active_learning_signal: model uncertainty + segmentation disagreement + high-impact topology errors → human review
stages.priority: Topology-affecting errors and model-uncertainty / disagreement cases—not cosmetic voxel fixes or obvious SAME faces
